aboutText: Middy's Melbourne has been the go-to electrical supplier since opening in 1956, offering an extensive range of data, electrical, industrial, lighting, and technology products. As a key branch of Middy's, we support electricians and businesses across Melbourne with quality supplies and expert advice. Our commitment to service and stock ensures you get exactly what you need for any project.
